posts.title: GPT-6 Astra beat Portal for $571.18
posts.summary: The Verge (Sep 6): user cozyblaze drove Astra through Valve's Portal end-to-end in under 24 hours for under $600 — fresh computer-use agent showcase.

posts.title: Travis Kalanick's Atoms might be getting into the robotaxi business
posts.summary: TechCrunch via FT: after a $1.7B raise, Atoms is reportedly hiring/acquiring toward AVs and has talked to Uber about robotaxi tech — Kalanick's 'unfinished business.'

posts.title: An Alien Mind — OpenAI chief scientist calls for voluntary slowdowns
posts.summary: AI/TLDR on Jakub Pachocki's Sep 6 essay: no lab has solved alignment/monitoring enough to keep scaling flat-out; expects voluntary pauses until shared safety bars exist.

posts.title: An Alien Mind

posts.title: Research acceleration at OpenAI — 3.1 agent workdays per human workday
posts.summary: AI/TLDR: OpenAI says it hit 'automated research intern' by Sep 2026; mid-August research org used 3.1 agent-workdays per human workday (median >$600/day inference).

posts.title: Chatbots built an 'echo chamber of one' — psychiatry weighs 'AI psychosis'
posts.summary: THE DECODER: King's College London and others examine whether AI-associated psychosis should become a clinical category as sycophantic chatbots amplify delusional loops.

posts.title: Google's WeatherNext 3 learns weather from live satellite data

posts.title: OpenAI developer: Astra pulled some plans forward by six months
posts.summary: THE DECODER: Thibault Sottiaux calls internal Astra the company's 'biggest competitive advantage' while gated; productivity jump allegedly advanced timelines ~6 months.

posts.title: Google brings Lyria 3.5 music generation into the Gemini app

posts.title: Lyria 3.5 comes to Gemini — Google's music model in app and API
posts.summary: AI/TLDR: model id lyria-3.5; worldwide Gemini app plus developer API for short/longer tracks with genre/style controls.

posts.title: Meta's real-time audio model for always-listening assistants
posts.summary: THE DECODER: Muse Voice Transcribe processes speech in 80ms chunks with speaker ID and sentence boundaries — foundation for glasses/agent listen modes.

posts.title: Stripping safety guardrails is now a turnkey commercial service
posts.summary: THE DECODER: Abliteration.ai sells modified open-weight models with trained safety mechanisms stripped — commercializes what was mostly a hobbyist technique.

posts.title: How Anthropic clinched $517B in compute deals in 11 months

posts.summary: TechCrunch: two more publishers allege scraping journalism to train ChatGPT/Copilot; suit calls generative AI a 'snake eating its own tail.'
